description: Waste and scrap of primary cells, primary batteries and electric accumulators; spent primary cells, spent primary batteries and spent electric accumulators

retired.note: HS 2022 created heading 85.49 for electrical and electronic waste and scrap. Battery waste moved from 8548.10 to 8549.11 through 8549.19, which together cover exactly what 8548.10 covered.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
